'''SAGroup''' was a sub-branch of the [[Commission for the Protection of the Republic/Legends|Commission for the Protection of the Republic]] (COMPOR), a political organization created to rally support for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Composed of adolescent citizens, SAGroup was [[Sub-Adult Group/Legends|reorganized]] as a part of the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] (COMPNOR) in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] following the [[Declaration of a New Order|formation]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].

==History==
{{Quote|This is sensationalist nonsense. These echelons that gathered today mark the first generation of the SAGroup brigadiers. We cannot help that the first to join happened to be of human descent. We have non-human applicants, to be sure. Their applications are still under review.|Crueya Vandron, addressing media concerns regarding membership within the SAGroup|<ref name="Insider 70" />}}
During the last [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and subsequent [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] resulted in a substantial increase in public support for the beleaguered Republic. As various [[Planet/Legends|planets]], [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] and [[Star system/Legends|star systems]] seceded to join the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], many pro-Republic citizens rallied to the newly-created [[Commission for the Protection of the Republic/Legends|Commission for the Protection of the Republic]] (COMPOR). A political movement dedicated to the preservation of the Republic, one of COMPOR's main objectives was to ensure its own future by recruiting younger generations into the organization's growing ranks. To that end, the Sub-Adult Group (SAGroup) was created as a sub-division of COMPOR.<ref name="Insider 70" />

However, the SAGroup was controversially&mdash;much like the rest of COMPOR&mdash;composed of a super majority of [[Human/Legends|Human]]-born citizens. On [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]], a youth rally was held at the [[Monument Plaza/Legends|Monument Plaza]] of [[Galactic City/Legends|Galactic City]] and broadcast by [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]]. While the rally itself was met with approval, critics disapproved of what they saw as [[Humanocentrism]] within the SAGroup. With roughly six thousand members in attendance, more than 95% were Human while the remainder were of [[near-Human]] descent. [[Crueya Vandron/Legends|Crueya Vandron]], a spokesperson for COMPOR, dismissed the media's criticism and stated that the organization was in the process of reviewing applications from [[Non-huMan|non-Humans]], although none had yet to be admitted. During the rally, SAGroup brigadier [[Nenevanth Tion]]&mdash;flanked by two [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]&mdash;gave a speech that praised [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] for his efforts to defend the Republic against the Separatist rebellion.<ref name="Insider 70" />

The end of the [[Cloning/Legends|Clone]] Wars in [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] not only signaled the Separatists' defeat, but also marked the Republic's [[Declaration of a New Order|transition]] into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. Soon after the newly-anointed [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] Palpatine established his reign over the galaxy, the Commission for the Protection of the Republic was renamed as the [[Commission for the Preservation of the New Order/Legends|Commission for the Preservation of the New Order]] (COMPNOR). The SAGroup remained intact, but would serve in a [[Sub-Adult Group/Legends|new capacity]] as a tool for indoctrinating the core tenets of the [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] into young Imperial citizens.<ref name="Insider 84" />
